programs.title: Louisiana Law
programs.desc: Deep in the woods and bayous of Louisiana, wildlife agents protect the state's resources; a crab fisherman is caught stealing dozens of traps, a hunter crosses state lines with an illegal deer and agents rescue an injured bald eagle.

programs.title: Louisiana Law
programs.desc: When a child is thrown from a boat and badly injured, wildlife agents are first on the scene; a night hunter faces multiple felony charges when agents make a grave discovery, agents confront a jet ski rider who risks drowning and gets belligerent.

programs.desc: When a pair of illegal hunters flee by truck, wildlife agents set out to track them down; heaps of trash dumped at a fishing spot lead to a suspect who denies any wrongdoing; damning evidence in a truck bed catches a hunter in a lie.

programs.title: Louisiana Law
